assist.desc: Miya works well with Tanks who have powerful CC abilities like Belerick and Tigreal since their CCs give her more opportunities to dish out damage.

strong.desc: Miya counters heroes who rely on targeted CC effects, such as Saber and Eudora, because she can easily escape their CC and respond with a strong counterattack. The split arrows from her 1st Skill are also very effective against heroes that summon units, such as Sun.

weak.desc: Miya is countered by heroes with a lot of AOE damage, such as Pharsa and Yve, because they can still hit her while she is concealed.

1.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_da894b37bfb5cadb32307f371f31918a.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Each time Miya hits a target with her Basic Attack, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4s. Stacks up to 5 times.

After reaching full stacks, Miya summons a <font color="a6aafb">Moonlight Shadow</font> with each Basic Attack that deals 30<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

Miya shoots two extra arrows with each Basic Attack, dealing 10<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target enemy and 30% damage to nearby targets. This effect lasts 4s. Each extra arrow inherits a portion of Attack Effects.

Miya launches an empowered arrow on the target area, dealing 270<font color="fba51f"> (+45% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s. The arrow then splits into 6 scattering minor arrows, each dealing 40<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

Miya removes all debuffs on her and conceals herself, gaining 35% extra Movement Speed. This state lasts 2s or until she launches an attack.

Miya gains full stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Moon Blessing</font> upon leaving the state.

assist.desc: Balmond is best with Support heroes that can boost his Mobility and Survivability. Examples include Angela and Rafaela.

strong.desc: Balmond is strong against squishy heroes who lack the ability to escape once he closes the gap on them, such as Layla and Eudora.

weak.desc: Balmond is countered by ranged heroes who can deal damage to Balmond outside of his attack range, such as Lesley and Irithel.

2.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_4df4ce8528166d6e1cc94480f4f0e910.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Balmond recovers 5% Max HP after killing a Minion or Creep, and 20% Max HP after killing a hero.

Balmond charges in the target direction for a set distance or until he hits an enemy hero, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way. The enemy hero hit will be knocked back slightly and slowed by 60% for 2s.

Balmond gains 15% Movement Speed that decays over time and spins with his axe for 3s, dealing 25<font color="fba51f"> (+25% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> per hit to nearby enemies up to 14 times. Each subsequent hit on the same enemy will deal 7.5% increased damage (up to 60%).

The Physical Attack bonus portion of the damage can Crit.

Balmond unleashes a huge strike in the target direction (cannot be interrupted), dealing <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> equal to 150<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> plus 30% of the target's lost HP.

This skill only deals up to 1000 damage to non-hero units.

skilllist.skilldesc: Saber's attacks reduce enemies' Physical Defense by 3-8 for 5s on hit. This effect stacks up to 5 times.

Saber releases 5 swords that orbit around him and deal 80<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies on hit. The swords will retract back to him after a while.

When the swords are present, Saber sends a sword at his target on each attack, dealing 210<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the target and 50% of the damage to other enemies it passes through (damage against Minions is reduced to 50%). Each sword attack also reduces the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Charge</font> by 1s.

Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way while enhancing his next Basic Attack. Saber can dash to the target, and his enhanced Basic Attack deals 75<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slows the target by 60% for 1s.

Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2s and striking them 3 times over the duration. The first two strikes deal 120<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each, while the third strike deals 240<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

assist.desc: To compensate for Alice's weaknesses in the early game and form a balanced team, pair her with strong early game heroes, like Balmond or Dyrroth.

strong.desc: With her great sustainability in combat plus her mobility and CC, Alice counters heroes that lack burst and can't escape from melee enemies, such as Cecilion and Chang'e.

weak.desc: Alice is countered by heroes with Execute or Healing Reduction who can impede her from healing herself during the Ultimate. Heroes like Baxia or Martis can reduce her healing or kill her before she can heal.

4.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_558cf35ad7d5f0cc4f0b4cbdf9498f9f.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Alice restores 3% Max Mana per second.
Each time Alice levels up, her Movement Speed increases by 3 and Healing Received increases by 1%.

Alice casts a sphere of blood energy in the target direction, dealing 400<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Alice immediately teleports to the blood sphere's location.

Alice deals 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+75% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 2.5<font color="62f8fe"> (+0.3% Total Mana)</font>% of the target's Max HP as <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and immobilizes them for 0.5s. skilllist.skilldesc:
Upon taking fatal damage, Nana removes all debuffs on her and transforms, becoming untargetable and invincible, and gains 30% Movement Speed for 2s. She also recovers 10% Max HP over the duration.

Nana can only transform once every 150s and cannot cast skills in the transformed form.

Nana hurls her Magic Boomerang in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies hit on its way out and back. The boomerang deals 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+90% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the first enemy hit. For every additional enemy hit, the damage is reduced by 10% (max reduction of 30%).

Nana throws Molina at the target location, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within range and <font color="a6aafb">Transforming</font> enemy heroes hit into small animals.

If Molina does not hit an enemy hero, she will remain on the ground and chase the nearest enemy hero that comes into range, <font color="a6aafb">Transforming</font> the first enemy hero she touches.

<font color="a6aafb">Transform</font>: Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 50% and Magic Defense by 30% for 1.5s. Transformed heroes cannot attack or use skills.

Nana summons Molina to strike the target area 3 times, each time dealing 440<font color="62f8fe"> (+140% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within and slowing them by 30% for 1s. Enemies hit consecutively will be stunned for 1s.

assist.desc: He's best with heroes with crowd control, such as Gatotkaca and Xavier, which makes up for his lack of powerful control abilities.

strong.desc: Alucard has great chase abilities and damage resistance, making him powerful against squishy Assassins like Harley and Aamon.

weak.desc:
But he can be countered by heroes with powerful control abilities like Franco and Johnson. If controlled, Alucard won't be able to steal HP
and can be easily eliminated.

7.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_0f51b6906e08897aa02330d65b0deeac.png

skilllist.skilldesc: After each skill cast, Alucard's next Basic Attack allows him to dash to the target's location and deal <font color="fba51f"> (+140% Total Physical Attack)</font> Physical Damage.

Alucard rolls to the target location and slams his blade on the ground, dealing 270<font color="fba51f"> (+110% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 2s.
Alucard launches a whirling slash, dealing 345<font color="fba51f"> (+120% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Alucard permanently gains 10% Hybrid Lifesteal.

<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Alucard absorbs the energy of enemies in the target area, reducing their Movement Speed by 30% and Hybrid Defense by 10. Alucard gains 10 Hybrid Defense for each enemy hero hit, and reduces the cooldown of his other skills to 50% for 6s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Alucard releases a shockwave in the target direction, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit.

assist.desc: Karina works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, such as Tigreal and Faramis, since her Ultimate and 2nd Skill also hits anyone near her main target, setting them up to be chain killed by her Ultimate.

strong.desc: Karina counters Marksmen that lack mobility, such as Layla and Hanabi, since her 1st Skill can neutralize their Basic Attacks and they can't escape her high mobility and burst damage.

weak.desc: Karina is countered by Tanky heroes with CC abilities, like Akai and Khufra because they can tank her damage, and protect their allies from her.

8.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_f49394186dc0e55d545da8377be83280.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Karina's third consecutive attack on the same enemy deals extra <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> equal to 50 plus 5<font color="62f8fe"> (+2.5% Total Magic Power)</font>% of their lost HP (up to 2000 <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> against creeps).

If the target is an enemy hero, the cooldowns of Karina's non-Ultimate skills are reduced by 1.5s.

Karina enters the <font color="a6aafb">Dance of Blades</font> state for 3.5s, during which she gains 45% extra Movement Speed, blocks all incoming Basic Attacks, and reflects 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> back to the attacker (the damage reflection effect has a cooldown of 0.4s).

Karina's next Basic Attack within the duration deals 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+55% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, slows the target by 45% for 1s, and is guaranteed to Crit. Casting the enhanced Basic Attack or <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Assault</font> ends the <font color="a6aafb">Dance of Blades</font> state early.
Karina launches a spinning slash, dealing 375<font color="62f8fe"> (+125% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

Karina dashes to the target enemy hero, dealing them 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+160% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, applying a <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font> to them, and leaving a <font color="a6aafb">Shadowform</font> behind them. The <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font> and <font color="a6aafb">Shadowform</font> both last 5s. If the enemy dies within the duration, the cooldown of this skill is reset.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Karina dashes back to the <font color="a6aafb">Shadowform</font>'s location, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies along the way.

Akai's Basic Attacks deal 25<font color="26e407"> (+5% Total HP)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to marked enemies.

Akai charges in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way. If Akai hits an enemy hero during this process, he'll knock them airborne for 0.5s and be able to roll in the Joystick's direction once.

Akai can cast <font color="a6aafb">Headbutt</font> during <font color="a6aafb">Heavy Spin</font> to quickly adjust his position.
Akai smashes the ground with his body, dealing 270<font color="26e407"> (+6% Total HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 45% for 2s.

Akai removes all debuffs on him and spins for 4s, gaining Slow Immunity while continuously dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Enemy heroes knocked back will knock back other heroes they collide with during the process.

Akai also gradually increases his Movement Speed by 70% over the duration. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression and Morph effects.

If no damage is taken within 5s, Franco gains 10% Movement Speed, recovers 1% Max HP per second, and begins accumulating <font color="a6aafb">Wasteland Force</font> (up to 10 stacks).

Franco will consume all <font color="a6aafb">Wasteland Force</font> stacks on his next skill cast to increase the skill's damage by up to 150%.

Franco launches an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dealing 400<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and dragging them to Franco.
Franco lashes out, dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 300 plus 4% of his Max HP to nearby enemies and slowing them by 70% for 1.5s.

Franco suppresses the target enemy hero for 1.8s and strikes them 6 times over the duration, each time dealing 50<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

10.story: Brave permafrost warrior, Bane's sworn enemy.

assist.desc: Bane works best with heroes like as Tigreal and Luo Yi who can pull enemies together so he can do even more damage with his AOE.

strong.desc: Bane counters Tanks with high HP but low damage, such as Hylos and Belerick, because he can out-sustain them and deals HP percentage-based damage.

weak.desc: Bane is countered by Mages that deal heavy damage from afar, such as Vale and Xavier who can deal significant damage to him before he can get in range.

11.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_7e4e74bb161da0f477cc0d1819fa39e6.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Bane infuses his weapon with a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Tidal Energy</font> each time he uses a skill (up to 2 stacks). Each of his subsequent Basic Attacks consumes a stack to deal <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to <font color="fba51f"> (+95% Total Physical Attack)</font> plus 4(+0.4*Hero Level)% of the target's Max HP to nearby enemies.

Bane fires his Crab Claw Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+160% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and then 150% damage to a random enemy behind them (prioritizes enemy heroes). Enemies hit are slowed by 10<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font>% for 1s.

Every 100 <font color="fba51f">Physical Attack</font> Bane possesses reduces this skill's cooldown by an additional 8%.

Bane chugs his ale, recovering 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 5<font color="62f8fe"> (+1.5% Total Magic Power)</font>% of his lost HP and gaining 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Bane spits venom in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+180% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (scales up to 150% with charging time) to enemies in a fan-shaped area.
Every 100 <font color="62f8fe">Magic Power</font> Bane possesses additionally reduces this skill's cooldown by 7%.

Bane summons a school of sharks to charge in the target direction, dealing 600<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+170% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit, knocking them airborne for 0.8s, and slowing them by 65% (decays over 3s).
This skill deals 40% damage to turrets.

13.story: A sharpshooter full of righteousness and justice.

assist.desc: When teamed up with Fighters like Freya and Lapu-Lapu, Rafaela can boost their offensive power and survivability.

strong.desc: Rafaela has great healing and decent mobility, and performs well against heroes that lack burst damage or mobility, such as Masha and Barats.

weak.desc: Rafaela struggles against bursty and agile Assassins, like Ling and Hayabusa.

14.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_68277dce415742c4a98883151c693a07.png

skilllist.skilldesc: When Rafaela is killed, she turns into a beam of <font color="a6aafb">Holy Light</font> and launches herself at her killer after a 2s delay. This attack deals <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> equal to 20% of the target's Max HP upon hit and can be blocked by other enemy heroes, dealing damage to them instead. This effect won't be triggered if the killer is a non-hero enemy or if they're too far away.

Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with <font color="a6aafb">Light of Retribution</font>, dealing them 225<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by <font color="a6aafb">Light of Retribution</font> again within 5s will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

Rafaela calls upon <font color="a6aafb">Holy Light</font>, restoring 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+35% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to nearby allied heroes, plus an additional 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+45% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. Also increases the Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1s.

Every 20 point(s) of Magic Power will add 1% to the Movement Speed bonus.

Rafaela unleashes the true power of <font color="a6aafb">Holy Light</font> in the target direction, dealing 460<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.2s.

assist.desc: Layla works best with Tanks that can protect backline heroes, such as Minsitthar and Belerick, since their protection gives Layla more opportunities to deal damage.

strong.desc: Layla's relatively longer attack range lets her counter slow Tanks like Tigreal and Belerick.

weak.desc: Layla is countered by Assassins with high burst damage, such as Karina and Ling, as they can get the jump on Layla and melt her easily.

18.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_b2b38e9406ea0de0b866db7674feea0f.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Layla deals increased damage to enemies farther away from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 115% at 6 units away). This does not include Turrets.

Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hit (can Crit).

Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and <font color="a6aafb">Void Projectile</font> gain extra range for 3s, and she gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.

Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target enemy that explodes on hit, dealing 170<font color="fba51f"> (+65% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to targets in the area and applying a <font color="a6aafb">Magic Mark</font> on them for 3s.
When Layla hits an enemy with a <font color="a6aafb">Magic Mark</font>, she deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+35% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.25s.

Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a line.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive:</font> The range of Layla's <font color="a6aafb">Void Projectile</font> and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units. Her sight range is also slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded.

18.story: The backbone of the Eruditio Rangers who is also known as the Shining Star.

assist.desc: Minotaur works best with burst damage Marksmen, such as Granger and Melissa, since his CC's give them more opportunities to deal damage.

strong.desc: Minotaur is strong against heroes that rely on chaining skills or attacks, like Paquito and Julian because he can interrupt their combos with his CC.

weak.desc: Minotaur is countered by long-range Marksmen like Layla and Lesley since his lack of speed makes him an easy target.

19.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_3ecd2c0843df7ec85044dafff6bf4553.png

skilllist.skilldesc: When Minotaur applies a control effect to an enemy hero with a skill, he will also reduce their Hybrid Defense by 5 (+0.5*Hero Level). When Minotaur heals an allied hero with a skill, he will also increase their Hybrid Defense by 5 (+0.5*Hero Level) for 2s. These effects are doubled in Enraged state.

Minotaur jumps to the target location, dealing 280<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them airborne. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 40% while Minotaur enhances his Basic Attacks to deal <font color="26e407"> (+3% Total HP)</font> extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> for 2s.

<font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font>: Increases the AOE range and the damage dealt by <font color="26e407"> (+3% Total HP)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>.

Minotaur motivates himself and nearby allied heroes, recovering 220<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to them and healing himself for 5% of his Lost HP.

<font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font>: Minotaur gains <font color="a6aafb">Enraged Regen</font> for 2s, during which he recovers HP equal to 100% of the damage taken from an enemy hero's Basic Attack.

Minotaur enters <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state and smashes the ground 3 times. The first 2 hits deal 180<font color="fba51f"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slow them by 40%, while the final hit deals 200<font color="ffe63c"> (+85% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> and knocks targets airborne. Minotaur is immune to control effects during this attack.

The <font color="a6aafb">Enraged</font> state lasts 12s and enhances Minotaur's skills for the duration.

19.story: Minoan prince determined to restore his homeland.

assist.desc: Due to her powerful defensive and CC abilities, Lolita is great at protecting Marksmen like Hanabi and Layla.

strong.desc: Lolita's shield makes her strong against heroes who rely on projectiles and ranged skills, such as Kimmy and Cyclops.

weak.desc: Lolita is countered by melee heroes with high burst damage like Ling and Paquito.

20.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_474cea36a4bfdc7bf7d94530853a99b2.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Every 5s, the Noumenon Energy Core grants a 80 (+16*Hero Level)<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> shield to Lolita and nearby allies, and an extra shield after a skill or the Ultimate is cast. This shield can stack up to 3 times and lasts 30s.

Lolita dashes in the target direction. Her next Basic Attack within 4s will perform a short dash to the target, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and stunning them for 0.5s. This damage is doubled against Minions.

Lolita raises her shield and reflects all incoming ranged Basic Attacks and <font color="a6aafb">Projectiles</font> in the direction of the shield for 3s. The shield will break after taking 1000<font color="26e407"> (+15% Total HP)</font> damage.

The damage and effects from the Unique Passives of an attacker's equipment will not apply to the shield and will not be reflected.

Lolita begins charging for 2s while slowing enemies in a fan-shaped area by 50%. When the charging is complete or is stopped, Lolita slams her hammer on the ground, dealing up to 500<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and stunning them for up to 2s (the damage and stun duration are based on the charge time).

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Lolita immediately stops charging and slams her hammer on the ground.

assist.desc: Hayabusa works best with Fighters like Lapu-Lapu and Alpha who can initiate with him to quickly focus down key targets.

strong.desc: Hayabusa counters squishy heroes that lack CC to shutdown the blinks from his 2nd Skill, and who are also easy targets for his Ultimate, such as Chang'e and Cecilion.

weak.desc: Hayabusa is countered by heroes with targeted CC like Franco and Kaja who can lock him down before he can blink away.

21.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_9cc074562291a02644a0ddae28eeaa42.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Shadow Mark</font> on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6s and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.

Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing 220<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2s. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens take 70% less damage after the first hit, and Creeps take 50% less damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy when hitting non-Minion enemies.

assist.desc: Pairing Freya with Tanks that have strong Crowd Control skills such as Belerick and Gatotkaca can provide her with more opportunities to deal damage.

strong.desc: Freya is excellent in sustained combat, making her a good counter against low damage Tanks like Uranus and Gloo.

weak.desc: Freya is countered by high mobility Fighters like Guinevere and Martis. Their ability to quickly disengage from combat hurts Freya's reliance on sustained damage.

22.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_85ecfab713c877196d4b9e44a2aa2f6a.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
After casting a skill, Freya gains 200% Attack Speed for her next 2 Basic Attacks (this effect can stack up to 6 times).

Freya gains 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orb</font> on each Basic Attack and can spend <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orb</font> stacks to cast <font color="a6aafb">Spirit Combo</font> consecutively.
Freya jumps to the target location, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and pulling them towards her.

Freya strikes in the target direction, gaining a 60<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Extra Physical Attack)</font> shield while dealing 20<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 0.5s. Freya can cast this skill again within 3.5s at the cost of 2 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orb</font>.

On the <font color="a6aafb">3rd cast</font>, Freya leaps into the air and smashes the area below, dealing 26<font color="fba51f"> (+108% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within range and knocking them airborne for 0.4s.

Freya gains 6 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Sacred Orb</font> and enters the <font color="a6aafb">Valkyrie</font> state, gaining a 600<font color="fba51f"> (+180% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield and 30 Physical Attack. Meanwhile, her Basic Attacks become ranged and deal <font color="a6aafb">splash</font> damage. The <font color="a6aafb">Valkyrie</font> state lasts for 10s.

assist.desc: Natalia works best with heroes with high AOE damage such as Yi Sun-shin and Vexana. She can stay hidden while they poke the enemy, then pounce on targets that get low on HP.

strong.desc: Natalia counters squishy heroes who lack CC and burst like as Novaria and Irithel since they can't stop Natalia's burst damage.

weak.desc: Natalia is countered by heroes who can restrict her mobility like Minsitthar and Kaja since they can easily shutdown her main advantage.

24.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_fbb5065b6ff174d1a20ccf5b7f523514.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
If Natalia stays in a bush without taking damage for 1s, she will enter <font color="a6aafb">Camouflage</font> state and gain 15% Movement Speed. In this state, Natalia's next Basic Attack will teleport her behind her target and deal 200<font color="fba51f"> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> while silencing the target for 0.25s.

Dealing damage, taking damage or using skills will immediately end the <font color="a6aafb">Camouflage</font> state, but her next Basic Attack will remain enhanced for another 1s.

Natalia's base Crit Damage is reduced to 150%, but her damage to Creeps is increased to 150%.

Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in her path.

After hitting an enemy, she can cast this skill again within 5s.
Natalia releases a <font color="a6aafb">Smoke Bomb</font> at her location, slowing enemies within by 25% while Natalia becomes immune to enemy Basic Attacks for 4s.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Natalia gains 15% extra Crit Chance.

<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Natalia immediately enters <font color="a6aafb">Assassin Instinct</font> state. Natalia can store up to 2 charges of her Ultimate and each charge has a recharge time of 30s. Creep kills will reduce the current remaining recharge time by 50% of the full recharge time.

skilllist.skilldesc: After traveling 5 units, Chou deals 180% damage on his next Basic Attack (cannot Crit) and briefly slows the target by 80%.

assist.desc: Ruby works best with heroes who can deal high AOE burst damage. Their skills can deal more damage to enemies who are stunned and pulled by her 2nd and Ultimate skills. Such as Pharsa and Kadita.

strong.desc: Ruby is strong against Fighter heroes with high burst damage. She can easily survive their burst with her excellent Regen and Lifesteal abilities. Such as Aldous and Guinevere.

weak.desc: Ruby is countered by Marksman heroes with good Mobility. Because they can easily dodge her 2nd and Ultimate skills. Like Wanwan and Irithel.

29.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_4b96c75b136290576d849309722d4d20.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Ruby starts with 5% Spell Vamp and her skills have a 125% Spell Vamp Ratio (but her Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal).

After each skill cast, Ruby can dash to another location and gain 9 (+1.8*Hero Level) Physical & Magic Defense (scales with level) for 4s (stacks up to 3 times).

Ruby swings her scythe, dealing 90<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit. She then unleashes a shockwave in the same direction, dealing 90<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.

Ruby swings her scythe around herself twice, each swing dealing 60<font color="fba51f"> (+55% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5s, and slowly pulling them toward her.

Ruby sweeps her scythe in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit, pulling them toward her, and stunning them for 0.5s.

assist.desc: Moskov works well with heroes like Atlas and Gatotkaca who can CC groups of enemies so he can focus on maximizing the damage of his piercing AOE.

strong.desc: Moskov's 1st Skill provides a blink effect, making him a threat to fighters with poor mobility like Thamuz and Balmond.

weak.desc: Moskov is countered by heroes with high mobility, such as Lancelot and Natalia, who can quickly close the gap and take him out.

31.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_a60a866ab6752a7f66766e720da987ea.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Moskov's Basic Attacks can penetrate the target and deal <font color="fba51f"> (+68% Total Physical Attack)</font>-<font color="fba51f"> (+110% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies behind them (scales with hero level). Each Basic Attack hit reduces the cooldowns of <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Walker</font> by 0.8s and <font color="a6aafb">Spear of Misery</font> by 0.8s.

Moskov teleports to the target location, increasing his Attack Speed to 1.15 times for 3s. Meanwhile, his Basic Attack deals <font color="fba51f"> (+10% Total Physical Attack)</font> more damage to enemies behind the primary target.

Moskov launches a powerful strike at the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font>, knocking them back, and revealing their position for 2s.

If the target collides with an enemy hero when knocked back, they'll both take 200<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and be stunned for 1.2s. If the enemy is knocked into a wall, they will also be stunned for the same duration.

After a short delay, Moskov throws the <font color="a6aafb">Spear of Destruction</font> in the target direction, dealing 340<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path and to the first enemy hero hit. Upon hitting an enemy hero, the spear pierces them, dealing 10% extra <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies behind them. The target and enemies hit by the piercing damage will be slowed by 50% for 1s (the slow duration scales with the spear's travel time, up to 3s).

When <font color="a6aafb">Spear of Destruction</font> hits the first enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and refreshes the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Walker</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Moskov casts <font color="a6aafb">Abyss Walker</font> from the shadow's location (shares the same cooldown as the skill).

31.story: A warrior of the desert that embraced the darkness to seek his revenge.

assist.desc: Johnson works well with heroes that need help initiating like Odette and Kadita since they can just jump into Johnson's Ultimate for a ride.

strong.desc:
Johnson counters melee heroes with high burst like Alucard and Zilong
because of Johnson's high Physical Defense and CC ability.

weak.desc: Johnson is countered by agile heroes who deal Magic Damage such as Harith and Kagura because they can easily dodge Johnson's skills while their damage is not affected by his Physical Defense.

32.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_85ff988c6660b4d04f8dd3d40df988bb.png

skilllist.skilldesc: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains a 300<font color="26e407"> (+700% Total Physical Defense)</font> shield for 10s. Cooldown: 100s.

Johnson throws his wrench toward the target location, dealing 120<font color="26e407"> (+220% Total Physical Defense)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8s.

Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing 80<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction and slowing them by 20%. Each instance of damage also increases the enemy's subsequent damage taken from the skill by 15% (up to 45%). This damage is increased by 60% against creeps.

Johnson can cast Basic Attacks and skills for the duration.

Johnson transforms into a car and begins accelerating over time. An allied hero can use <font color="a6aafb">Hop In</font> when near Johnson to board the car (only 1 allied hero can ride with Johnson). The car will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or obstacle, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+160% Total Magic Power)</font>-450<font color="62f8fe"> (+280% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5-1s (scales with the car's speed before impact), and creating an electrified zone at the location. The zone continuously deals 60<font color="62f8fe"> (+20% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slows enemies within. While in car state, tap <font color="a6aafb">Brake</font> to stop immediately or hold <font color="a6aafb">Nitrous</font> to continuously gain speed for up to 5s. Johnson's location will be revealed to the enemy team for 3s when casting this skill.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Johnson's Physical Defense is increased by 10%.

assist.desc: Estes works best with typical Marksman heroes, his healing will allow them to deal more damage. Heroes like Lesley and Hanabi are good examples here.

strong.desc: Estes counters heroes with no burst damage, he can easily heal through minor damages from heroes like Faramis and Alice.

weak.desc: Estes is countered by heroes with high burst damage. Heroes like Saber and Eudora can easily burst down Estes or the hero he protects in a few seconds.

34.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_ff4de3b0aabd1d2f6e184db1c831f6a9.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Scripture of the Moon Elf slowly charges Estes with energy. When the energy reaches 100 stacks, Estes' next Basic Attack will become enhanced, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the target and 125<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 60% for 1.5s.

Estes restores 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+110% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to the target allied hero immediately and links himself with them for 3s, slowly restoring 325<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to the target. Linking with an allied hero will also increase Estes' Hybrid Defense by 20 and Movement Speed by 15%, as well as the energy charging speed of the Scripture of the Moon Elf.

Being too far from the target will break the link.

Estes drops a flood of moonlight on the target area, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+70% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemy units within it. Afterwards, it turns to a domain of the Moon Goddess and reveals enemies inside it. Enemies will be slowed by 90% for 1.5s if they touch the edge of the domain area. (The slow effect will decay over time.)

Estes casts an enhanced <font color="a6aafb">"Moonlight Immersion"</font> on all nearby allied heroes. Within the next 8s, <font color="a6aafb">"Moonlight Immersion"</font> will be enhanced and Estes will continuously recover 1230<font color="62f8fe"> (+210% Total Magic Power)</font> HP.

assist.desc: Hilda works well with tanky heroes, which can create room for her to dish out more damage. Such as Atlas and Tigreal.

strong.desc: Hilda excels in prolonged battles. She works well against heroes with lower burst damage. Such as Zilong and Layla.

weak.desc: Hilda is countered by heroes with high sustain. Such as Thamuz and Uranus. This is because they can utilize their healing abilities to prevent being executed.

35.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_acd700708dc515f5c63a08f8835a9941.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Hilda regenerates 2% of her max HP per second while in the bush. When entering the bush, she gains a shield equal to 15% of her max HP. After leaving the bush, the shield lasts for 5s. This effect has a 10s cooldown.

Hilda's Basic Attack and Skills apply a <font color="a6aafb">Wilderness Mark</font> on hit, which lasts up to 4s and stacks up to 6. Each stack reduces the target's Physical Defense and Magic Defense by 4%.

Hilda activates the runic power of her great axe, increasing her Movement Speed by 60% for 3s and enhancing her next Basic Attack to deal 200<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and slow the target by 40% for 3s. Aurora creates a frost path in the target direction, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in the path and reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1.2s. The frost path gradually becomes glaciers that spread until reaching their maximum size and shattering, dealing 600<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to all enemies in the area and freezing targets for 1s. Every 100 Magic Power that Aurora has will increase the freeze duration by 0.2s.

assist.desc: Lapu-Lapu works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, like Tigreal and Atlas, to allow his AOE skills to hit more targets and get more Damage Reduction from his 2nd Skill in Great Sword stance by hitting more heroes.

strong.desc: Lapu-Lapu is strong against squishy heroes who lack movement abilities, such as Layla and Eudora, because he has high burst damage and can use his mobility to get on top of them.

weak.desc: Lapu-Lapu is countered by agile Marksmen who can knock him away, such as Lesley and Moskov. They can speed up or blink to avoid Lapu-Lapu's Ultimate, and use knockback effects to interrupt his 1st Skill in Great Sword stance or to keep him away.

37.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_28036c4584c914c5aad4d2feeafb2452.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Lapu-Lapu accumulates 10 <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> each time he deals damage (halved for damage dealt to non-hero units). When <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> is full, Lapu-Lapu's next <font color="a6aafb">Basic Attack</font> will make him dash toward the target, dealing <font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> (cannot Crit) and granting him a shield that absorbs 250 (+65*Hero Level) damage for 2.5s.

Lapu-Lapu releases two boomerangs in the target direction, each boomerang dealing 140<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit on its way out and back.

Enemies hit by both boomerangs take 50% damage from the second hit.
Lapu-Lapu dashes in the target direction, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way.

Lapu-Lapu leaps to the target location while combining his twin blades into one, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies upon landing and slowing them by 60% for 1s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.)
Lapu-Lapu gains 3 times the <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> from this skill and skills in transformed state.
For the next 10s, Lapu-Lapu enters <font color="a6aafb">Great Sword</font> stance and gains enhanced skills, 30 extra Physical & Magic Defense, and his Basic Attack damage is increased to 120%.

Lapu-Lapu accumulates 10 <font color="a6aafb">Bravery Blessing</font> each time he deals damage (halved for damage dealt to non-hero units). Lapu-Lapu channels for 0.7s, slowing enemies in the target direction by 60%. He then slams his heavy sword to the ground, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and stunning them for 1s.

Lapu-Lapu whirls his heavy sword, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies.

For each enemy hero hit, Lapu-Lapu gains 10% extra Damage Reduction for 4s.

Lapu-Lapu swings his heavy sword 3 times. The first two attacks deal 345<font color="fba51f"> (+160% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> each, while the third deals 440<font color="fba51f"> (+210% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a large area.

Lapu-Lapu gains Control Immunity during this process and can change his attack direction and move a short distance on each attack.

skilllist.skilldesc: Vexana and the <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Guard</font> inflict <font color="a6aafb">Nether Curse</font> on enemies hit. The Curse lasts 5s and will cause the affected enemy to explode upon death, dealing 108-500<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies (base damage scales with level).

Vexana unleashes a <font color="a6aafb">Deathly Grasp</font> in the target direction, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path. The projectile stops upon hitting an enemy hero, terrifying them and knocking them back, then it explodes, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and terrifying them for 1s.

Vexana marks the target area with the power of the undead, striking it after a 0.8s delay and dealing 580<font color="62f8fe"> (+165% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.

Vexana summons an <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Guard</font> at the target location, dealing 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s. The <font color="a6aafb">Eternal Guard</font> then joins Vexana in battle for 15s. Each of the Eternal Guard's attacks deals 225<font color="62f8fe"> (+40% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 5% of the target's Max HP as <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a large area.

assist.desc: Roger works best with heroes with high AOE damage that can nuke the enemy team to low HP for him to finish off, such as Pharsa and Vexana.

strong.desc: Roger counters squishy heroes that lack mobility such as Hanabi and Odette because they cannot easily escape from him.

weak.desc: Roger is countered by heroes that can restrict his mobility and prevent him from jumping in and out using his two forms, like Minsitthar and Khufra.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.

In human form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP.

In wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP.

This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.

Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> in total to the enemy hit. The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5s, while the second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by 10 for 5s.
Roger gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed for 2.5s.

Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8s.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: In wolf form, Roger gains 40 Physical & Magic Defense and 25 Movement Speed.

Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms.

In human form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP.

In wolf form, Roger's Basic Attack and skills deal additional damage equal to 4% of the target's lost HP.

This effect can only deal up to 60 additional damage against Creeps.

Roger lunges at the target enemy, becoming untargetable while dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+125% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to up to 3 enemies in the area.

Getting a kill or assist will reduce the cooldown of this skill by 80%.
Roger lets out a howl, increasing his Attack Speed by 1.15 times for 5s. Within this duration, he gains 50% Movement Speed if an enemy hero below 40% HP is within his vision.
Roger rolls in the target direction and reverts back to human form, gaining a 200<font color="fba51f"> (+200% Extra Physical Attack)</font> shield for 1.5s.

Assassins like Saber and Aamon who can eliminate

skilllist.skilldesc: Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Lightwheel Mark</font> on hit. Once a target has 5 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Lightwheel Marks</font>, the marks will turn into a lightwheel, dealing <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> equal to 5<font color="fba51f"> (+1% Extra Physical Attack)</font>% of the target's Max HP to them (only up to 300 damage against Creeps).

Karrie releases a sphere of surging energy in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its max travel distance, continuously dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+20% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 80% for 1s.

Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and applying a stack of <font color="a6aafb">Lightwheel Mark</font> on them.

When in <font color="a6aafb">Dual Wield</font> state, Karrie throws two lightwheels instead.

Karrie enters <font color="a6aafb">Dual Wield</font> state for 10s, during which she gains 20% Movement Speed and throws two lightwheels with each Basic Attack, each dealing 50% Basic Attack damage and inheriting a portion of Attack Effects.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Gatotkaca gains Physical Defense equal to 2% of his lost HP (up to 200). For every 300 damage he takes (calculated before damage reduction), he gains 5 Rage (up to 100).

Upon reaching over 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next Basic Attack becomes enhanced, consuming all Rage to deal extra <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and recover HP. The extra damage scales with his Rage, level, and Magic Power.

Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a shattered zone in the target direction while dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within. Enemies in the shattered zone will take 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+20% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> per second and be slowed by 30%.

Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, forcing enemies on the path to attack him and deal 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> for 1.5s. The sprint distance scales with the channel time. Canceling the Skill reduces 50% of the remaining Cooldown.

Gatotkaca jumps to the target location, dealing 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+300% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 1s. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked airborne for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled to the center.

The camera will move with the skill indicator but won't grant extra sight.

assist.desc: Harley is best with heroes who can disrupt the enemy formation like Akai and Khufra. He can follow them into the fight and burst down the squishy targets.

strong.desc: Harley counters squishy heroes with poor mobility, such as Cecilion and Ixia, since he can deal burst damage while being on the move.

weak.desc: Harley is countered by tanky heroes like Lolita and Uranus, because Harley can't deal enough meaningful damage to them and they can block and tank his Ultimate for their teammates.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Harley's mastery of magic allows his Basic Attacks and skills to reduce the enemy's Magic Defense by 2 and increase his Attack Speed by 5%-10% (scales with level) for 3s on hit. This effect stacks up to 10 times.
Harley's Basic Attacks deal 60<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Harley throws 3 waves of cards (3 cards per wave), with each card dealing 130<font color="62f8fe"> (+25% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies.
After the same target is hit 3 times, the damage will decay to 50% on subsequent hits.

Harley blinks in the designated direction, leaving a magic hat at his starting location and increasing his Movement Speed by 60% for 2s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Use again within 4s to return to the hat's location and cancel the Movement Speed effect.

Harley casts a magic ring of fire at an enemy hero, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. The ring will stay around the target, during which Harley can hit the ring to damage the target. The ring will explode after 4s, dealing <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> plus 30% of the damage taken by the target while the ring was active.

<font color="A4AAC7">The ring of fire can be blocked by other enemy heroes before it reaches its target.</font>

assist.desc: Irithel works best with heroes that can slow or provide hard CC such as Valir and Hylos because they allow her more opportunities to deal damage.

strong.desc: Irithel counters heroes with a shorter Basic Attack range than her or ones that lack mobility and can be easily kited, such as Miya and Alpha.

weak.desc: Irithel is countered by heroes with strong CC capabilities or can restrict movement, such as Badang and Silvanna. Because Irithel does not have any Blink skills, her advantage vanishes once her mobility is restricted.

assist.desc: Grock works well with heroes who have skills that synergize with walls, such as Moskov and Barats. With Grock's stone wall, they can CC enemies more easily with their skill mechanics.

strong.desc:
Grock counters heroes who are reliant on skills to deal Physical Damage, such as Terizla and Lapu-Lapu, thanks to the additional Physical Defense
from his Passive.

weak.desc: Grock is weak against Mages who can pass through obstacles or are very nimble like Novaria and Valentina, because his Passive and stone wall are not very effective against them.

skilllist.skilldesc:
When near a wall or turret, Grock gains 10% Movement Speed, 15 (+8*Hero Level) Physical Defense, and 18 (+4.8*Hero Level) HP Regen.

Each point of Grock's extra Physical Attack increases his Physical Defense by 0.5.

Grock charges his weapon with the <font color="a6aafb">Power of Nature</font> and then launches a powerful sweep, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+160% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 2s. Damage dealt will increase the longer the skill is channeled, up to 250%.

Using <font color="a6aafb">Power of Nature</font> near a wall will grant Control Immunity.

Grock conjures a stone wall at the target location, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies. The stone wall lasts 5s and can block enemies who try to pass through.

Grock charges in the target direction, dealing 360<font color="fba51f"> (+75% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in his path and knocking them airborne.

If he hits a wall or turret during the charge, he deals an additional 360<font color="fba51f"> (+90% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to nearby enemies and stuns them for 1.8s.

assist.desc: Argus works well with utility Supports like Angela and Rafaela who can provide extra Movement Speed and CC to allow Argus to stick to his targets and dish out maximum damage.

strong.desc: Argus counters heroes with poor mobility who cannot escape his attacks once he closes in, such as Gord and Aurora.

weak.desc: Argus is countered by Tanks with high Physical Defense, like Gatotkaca and Tigreal, because a lot of his damage comes from Basic Attacks.

45.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_0bd96658e5b8ec578226ea1622bd7231.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
When Argus' Meteoric Sword reaches 100 <font color="a6aafb">Malice Energy</font>, he will launch a <font color="a6aafb">Demonic Slash</font> with his next Basic Attack, dealing 200<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and recovering 200<font color="fba51f"> (+10% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP. This attack ignores 40% of the target's Physical Defense.

Argus' Meteoric Sword gains 5 <font color="a6aafb">Malice Energy</font> per second, and each of his Basic Attacks grants 10 <font color="a6aafb">Malice Energy</font> (critical strikes grant an additional 5 energy).

Argus stretches out a demonic hand in the target direction, dealing 125<font color="fba51f"> (+60% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the first enemy hero or Creep hit, stunning them for 0.7s, and pulling him and the target towards each other. If no enemy is hit, Argus pulls himself toward the hand's destination instead.

skilllist.skilldesc:

Odette's skills will also trigger this effect when hitting an enemy. This effect stacks up to 3 times.

Odette releases a set of magic energy balls in the target direction, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.5s. After hitting an enemy, another energy ball will split off and attack a nearby enemy (prioritizes enemy heroes), dealing them 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+50% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

Odette begins to dance, gaining a 1400<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> shield while dealing up to 2400<font color="62f8fe"> (+900% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in a large area around her for 5s. The bounce speed and frequency of <font color="a6aafb">Lakeshore Ambience</font>'s sound wave in the area are also enhanced when the skill is active.
Use again while the skill is active to dash in the target direction.

46.story: Innocent princess that grew up in the Swan Castle and genius mage that excels in sword and scepter.

assist.desc: Lancelot works well with heroes who can pull enemies together, like Atlas and Tigreal, because they allow him to hit more enemies with his AOE skills.

strong.desc: Lancelot counters long-range Mages, such as Cecilion and Pharsa, because there is a delay to their skills and Lancelot can use his 1st Skill to dodge them while going in for the kill.

weak.desc: Lancelot is weak against heroes who can counter his mobility like Minsitthar and Phoveus, as his 1st Skill and Ultimate will be heavily restricted.

47.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_dc4b821e49b904715172136017798da3.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Each time Lancelot charges, his damage is increased by 7.5% for 4s, up to 30%.

Lancelot charges in the target direction, dealing 100<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies along the way and applying a <font color="a6aafb">Sword Mark</font> to the first unmarked enemy hit. The <font color="a6aafb">Sword Mark</font> lasts 5s.

If Lancelot successfully applies a <font color="a6aafb">Sword Mark</font> to an enemy, the cooldown of this skill will reset.

Lancelot strikes in the target direction 3 times, each time dealing 170<font color="fba51f"> (+130% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit (damage is reduced when multiple enemies are hit). He's untargetable and invincible during this process. Enemies in the center of the area take all the 3 hits and are slowed by 20% for 0.5s. The slow effect can stack.

After a short delay, Lancelot performs an executioner's strike in the target direction, dealing 350<font color="fba51f"> (+170% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies hit. He is invincible throughout the process.

47.story: Prodigal son and genius swordsman of House Baroque.

assist.desc: Diggie works best with Marksmen that lack mobility or survivability like Layla and Miya because his skills can protect them very well.

strong.desc: Diggie counters close range, CC focused heroes like Atlas and Lolita since he can pull them away and remove their CCs with his Ultimate.

weak.desc: Diggie is countered by agile and bursty Assassins like Ling and Aamon because his own lack of defense makes him an easy target.

48.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_b1bdf46136cb8a7903dae6d58e8349cb.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Upon death, Diggie reverses time and turns back to egg form, in which he can continue to move around and gains a new set of skills. He cannot be targeted in egg form and will revive after a period of time.

Diggie flings an owl alarm to the target location that remains stationary for 25s or until it reacts to the first enemy in range, chasing them and exploding upon collision. The explosion deals 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and slows them by 30%.

Diggie gains 2 stacks of <font color="a6aafb">Dangerous Sparks</font> each time an enemy hero is hit by the explosion (up to 60 stacks), each stack increasing the skill's damage by 1%. He loses half the stacks upon death, but can gain 1 stack of <font color="a6aafb">Dangerous Sparks</font> each time his skill hits an enemy hero when in egg form.

Up to 5 owl alarms can exist at the same time.

Diggie marks the target enemy hero for 4s and pulls them back to their previous location after the duration ends, dealing 150<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and briefly slowing them by 80%.

If the enemy moves out of the circle, the pull will be triggered early.

Diggie removes all debuffs on nearby allied heroes (including himself) and grants them a 650<font color="62f8fe"> (+300% Total Magic Power)</font> shield and Control Immunity for 2s. He also gains 50% Movement Speed for 0.5s.

48.story: The owl scholar who can control time.

assist.desc:
Hylos works best with heroes that need faster Movement Speed to engage,
such as Terizla and Minsitthar.

strong.desc: Hylos is strong against heroes without mobility skills that can't easily escape his 2nd Skill, like Layla and Gord.

weak.desc: Hylos is countered by high mobility heroes like Karrie and Lesley, as they are hard for him to lock down and can also take him out.

skilllist.skilldesc:
Hylos gains 1.5 extra Max HP for every 1 extra Max Mana he possesses.

When out of Mana, Hylos can use his HP for skill casts.

Hylos gains 50% Movement Speed and causes his next Basic Attack within 3s to deal 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the target, and knock back and stun them for 1s.

<font color="A4AAC7">This damage counts as Skill Damage.</font>

<font color="A4AAC7">The extra Movement Speed rapidly decays over the duration and ends after the next Basic Attack.</font>

Hylos releases the <font color="a6aafb">Ring of Punishment</font>, dealing 100<font color="62f8fe"> (+20% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4% and reducing their Attack Speed by 7.5% for 2.5s (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the enemy's damage taken from the <font color="a6aafb">Ring of Punishment</font> by 5%. The <font color="a6aafb">Ring of Punishment</font> consumes 30 Mana per second when it's active.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Hylos cancels the <font color="a6aafb">Ring of Punishment</font>.

Hylos creates a huge pathway in the target direction, reducing enemies' Movement Speed by 75% for 1s. The pathway lasts 6s.
When on the pathway, Hylos gains Slow Immunity and recovers 3% of his Max HP per second. Allied heroes moving along the pathway gain 60% extra Movement Speed, while enemy heroes on the pathway will be slowed by 25%.

assist.desc: Zhask works best with heroes that can lock down enemies so he can have more time to deal damage, like Belerick and Lolita.

strong.desc: Zhask is strong against burst damage heroes like Aldous and Paquito because his high HP after fusing with his Nightmaric Spawn, makes him tough to burst down.

weak.desc: Zhask is countered by agile or long range heroes, such as Pharsa and Cecilion, because they can quickly step out of range of his immobile Nightmaric Spawn.

50.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_d8f170087cb2d5b71bb22a0a4664a927.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

Zhask summons a <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> that gains 50% of his Attributes plus an additional 15 <font color="62f8fe">Magic Power</font>. <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> will automatically attack nearby enemies, each attack dealing 60<font color="26e407">(+20 Extra Attack Speed)</font> (+<font color="62f8fe">20% Magic Power</font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. After every 3 attacks, it fires a <font color="a6aafb">Death Ray</font> at the target, dealing 30% (+<font color="62f8fe">0.6 Magic Power</font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and slowing them by up to 180% for s. If Zhask is too far away from <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font>, it will disappear.
<font color="a6aafb">Death Ray</font> is considered a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.
<font color="a6aafb">Fusion Enhanced</font>: The damage of <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> is increased to , and it can be repositioned.

Zhask fires a penetrating psychic beam in the designated direction, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies along the way. <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> will also cast <font color="a6aafb">Mind Eater</font> at the same location. If an enemy is hit by both beams, they will be stunned for 120<font color="62f8fe"> (+80% Total Magic Power)</font>s.

<font color="a6aafb">Fusion Enhanced</font>: The damage of Zhask and <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> is fused together, dealing 0.5 <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.

Zhask releases a swarm of <font color="a6aafb">Hive Clones</font> in the targeted direction. The clones will explode and deal 55<font color="62f8fe"> (+18% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies on contact, reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1s. 
If <font color="a6aafb">Hive Clones</font> find no target, they will burrow into the ground and ambush enemies passing by.
<font color="a6aafb">Fusion Enhanced</font>: Zhask releases several swarms of <font color="a6aafb">Hive Clones</font>.
Subsequent damage dealt to the same target decays to 20%.

Zhask combines himself with the <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font>, greatly increasing its attributes while enhancing Zhask's skills.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Zhask leaves the <font color="a6aafb">Nightmaric Spawn</font> and loses the skill enhancement effect.

assist.desc: Helcurt's Ultimate is a great tool to obscure the enemy's vision and makes it easier for him and his team to engage. Additionally, heroes with CC like Tigreal, Esmeralda, and Terizla work great with Helcurt to secure kills.

strong.desc: Helcurt can swiftly approach enemies with his mobility and quickly take down heroes like Layla, Chang'e, and Vale with his burst damage.

weak.desc: Helcurt should avoid tank heroes that he can't burst down, such as Fredrinn, Belerick, and Gatotkaca. Once Helcurt is caught by their CC, they can make short work of him with their teammates.

51.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_6abf0c552b59b8ca4cbc1af3662ef176.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
Helcurt remains in <font color="a6aafb">Prowler</font> state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% extra Movement Speed, and continuously regenerating <font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> HP if he has not dealt any damage.
He gains 50% extra Attack Speed and 50% extra Movement Speed (decreasing over time) for 4s upon being spotted and leaves <font color="a6aafb">Prowler</font> state 0.75s later.
Any hero killed after being hit by Helcurt leaves a <font color="a6aafb">dark fog</font> that explodes and spreads with a cooldown of 10s. Helcurt <font color="a6aafb">Conceals</font> himself while within the <font color="a6aafb">dark fog</font>.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: When Helcurt is in <font color="a6aafb">Prowler</font> state, the skill <font color="a6aafb">terrifies</font> enemy heroes hit and its cooldown decreases 3 times as fast as normal.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Helcurt blinks to the target location and deals 150<font color="fba51f"> (+70% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies within the area, reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 0.75s.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Helcurt gains one Deadly Stinger for every 1.5s spent in <font color="a6aafb">Prowler</font> state or on each Basic Attack. Up to 5 <font color="a6aafb">stingers</font> can be stored.
<font color="a6aafb">Active</font>: Helcurt fires all <font color="a6aafb">Deadly Stingers</font> forward, each dealing 180<font color="fba51f"> (+42% Extra Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies (Minions and Creeps take only 70% of the damage).
<font color="a6aafb">Deadly Stinger</font> counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

Helcurt summons the Dark Night, reducing all enemies' sight range and making them lose sight of their allies for 3s. During Dark Night, Helcurt gains 40% extra Movement Speed.

The Dark Night makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.

assist.desc: Pharsa is best with heroes who can CC the enemy so that her skills can hit them. Atlas and Franco are good examples of this.

strong.desc: Pharsa can deal high burst damage from a very long range. A great counter to enemy back-row heroes with poor Mobility, such as Layla, Hanabi and Xavier.

weak.desc: Pharsa should beware of any displacement ability skill. Heroes like Franco, Zilong and Minsitthar can easily interrupt Pharsa's Ultimate.

skilllist.skilldesc: Every 8s, Verri enters the Hunting state and assists Pharsa on her next attack against an enemy hero, dealing 8% extra <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> equal to the target's Max HP (+ 1% for every 200 Magic Power owned) and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

Pharsa unleashes a blast of magic at the target location, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit and marking them for 4s.

Pharsa's subsequent attack against marked enemies will consume the mark and stun them for 1s.
Pharsa releases magic energy in the target direction, dealing 525<font color="62f8fe"> (+145% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies hit.

Pharsa takes flight for 8s and bombards the target location, dealing 570<font color="62f8fe"> (+160% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies within the area. This skill can be cast up to 4 times within the duration.

Pharsa turns into mist and wraps herself around Verri, gaining 135% extra Movement Speed (decreasing over time) and the ability to fly over terrain. This state lasts up to 5s or until she uses a Basic Attack or skills, or is controlled.

The skill's cooldown is reduced by 0.5s each time Pharsa levels up.

assist.desc: Lesley works best with tank heroes who can provide better attacking conditions for her, like Minotaur and Baxia.

strong.desc: Lesley is strong against tank heroes who rely heavily on equipment. Because her attacks can deal True Damage that will ignore the defense these heroes get from the equipment. Such as Gatotkaca and Fredrinn.

weak.desc: Lesley is countered by Assassin heroes with multiple movement abilities, which will cause her to lose her range advantage. Such as Ling and Lancelot.

53.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_08770893183018333f54a98e63c41ee3.png

skilllist.skilldesc:
If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5s, her next Basic Attack gains extra range and 50% Crit Chance and deals 100<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="ffe63c">True Damage</font> (20% extra damage against minions).

Each point of fixed Physical Penetration Lesley acquires is converted into 0.5% Crit Damage, but her base Crit Damage is reduced to 130%.

Lesley's Basic Attack restores 5 points of energy and her <font color="a6aafb">Lethal Shot</font> doubles the amount of energy restored. The <font color="a6aafb">Lethal Shot</font> effect will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.

Lesley enters the Camouflage state, gaining double Energy Regen, 40% extra Movement Speed, and 85 extra Physical Attack.

The state lasts 3s or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's position through distortions of their surroundings.

Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while jumping back slightly, dealing 150<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in a fan-shaped area and knocking them back.

Lesley can cast this skill during <font color="a6aafb">Ultimate Snipe</font> to cancel the state and immediately fire a Fatal Bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are unfired Fatal Bullets left.

Lesley locks onto the target enemy hero and fires 4 Fatal Bullets in succession, each dealing <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> equal to 250<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Extra Physical Attack)</font> plus 5% of their lost HP and restoring 10 energy on hit. The Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes.

If this skill is interrupted, each remaining Bullet reduces the skill cooldown by 10%.

<font color="a6aafb">Passive</font>: Lesley's Crit Chance is increased by 5%.

53.story: Adopted daughter of House Vance, a clandestine sniper.

assist.desc: Jawhead works best with heroes that benefit from a quick engage like Odette and Belerick because he can throw them into the enemy for a surprise attack.

strong.desc: Jawhead counters squishy heroes with no defensive skills that he can burst down after connecting with his Ultimate, such as Saber and Eudora.

weak.desc: Jawhead is countered by heroes with high sustained damage or high survivability, like Edith and Thamuz, because they can survive Jawhead's burst damage and beat him in a prolonged battle.

54.head: https://akmweb.youngjoygame.com/web/svnres/img/mlbb/homepage/100_bd87c30b6c7de6ae3b5aa56162c48c8b.png

skilllist.skilldesc: Each time Jawhead deals damage to an enemy hero or a Creep, he inflicts a stack of Mecha Suppression on them for 3s (up to 6 stacks). Each stack of Mecha Suppression increases all damage dealt to the target by 2%.

Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies over 5s, each missile dealing 135<font color="fba51f"> (+30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to the enemy hit.

Jawhead gains 30% Movement Speed and a 500<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> shield for 5s.

<font color="a6aafb">Use Again</font>: Jawhead flings the nearest unit (prioritizes heroes) to the target location, dealing 300<font color="fba51f"> (+80% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5s. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

Jawhead charges into the target enemy hero, dealing 350<font color="fba51f"> (+150% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="fb1f1f">Physical Damage</font> and briefly stunning them. Enemies around the target are knocked back and dealt the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects during the charge.
